title: Northgate Optical Desk Guidance: One Discount Route per Eyewear Job
content:
A Northgate Optical eyewear job is billed either with the member's vision plan or with the Plus lens discount, never both, because on every lens design the Plus discount is not combinable with vision plan billing.

**The rule the desk applies.** When the job shows a vision plan billed, the Plus discount is not applied. When the job shows no vision plan, the Plus discount applies if the membership on the job was held at Northgate Club Plus Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership on the job's order date.

**Whose membership counts.** A job belongs to the membership presented on it. Eyewear for a household dependent is ordered under the primary member's membership, which every lens design allows. The patient's own membership, if the patient has one, has no bearing on the job.

**Evidence.** Both questions are answered from the system record of that eyewear job — the vision plan billed on it and the membership presented on it, with that membership's tier on the order date — and not from what the caller says. The record consulted is the job itself, identified by its eyewear job reference number.

### Decision table

| Vision plan on the job | Membership on the job at a Plus tier on the order date | Plus lens discount |
|---|---|---|
| a plan is billed | yes | not applied |
| a plan is billed | no | not applied |
| none | yes | applied |
| none | no | not applied |

### Points of judgement

- *A Plus member's job is billed to EyeMed.* The Plus discount is not applied; the vision plan route governs the job.
- *A member upgraded to Club Plus after the order date.* The tier on the order date decides; a Plus tier reached later does not bring the discount onto that job.
- *A dependent who holds a Plus membership of their own has eyewear ordered under a parent's base-tier membership.* The job belongs to the parent's membership presented on it; the dependent's own Plus membership has no bearing.
